command:
sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects.
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0

ANTRIEB_EOF
